The '''Fuel Transfer Limpet Controller''' launches limpets that draw fuel out of the controlling ship's own tank and deliver it to a targeted ship, refuelling it in flight.

== Overview ==

Fuel Transfer limpets are one of four original Limpet Controller types (alongside [[Collector Limpet Controller|Collector]], [[Hatch Breaker Limpet Controller|Hatch Breaker]], and [[Prospector Limpet Controller|Prospector]]), and are the tool behind community fuel-rescue operations for Commanders stranded with an empty tank, as well as general fleet support for wingmates running low on fuel far from a station.

{{Field note|A Fuel Transfer limpet moves fuel from '''your''' tank to the target's — it does not create fuel, so the donor ship needs enough reserve fuel to spare before offering a transfer.}}
